<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Rich text: the body of the current page or post (trusted markup from the content source) styled by Prose,
  under its title and a meta line (date, author, category). Axes: layout (narrow: one reading column; wide: a
  wider column; sidebar: the body and a side note; media: a cover above the body; card: the body in a card;
  hero: the title as the page heading over a wide cover), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { RichEntry, RichMedia, RichMeta, RichAside } from "./rich-text.types";
import type { TrustedHtml } from "../utils";

export type RichTextProps = {
  id: string;
  title?: string;
  content?: TrustedHtml;
  media?: RichMedia;
  meta?: RichMeta;
  aside?: RichAside;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  layout?: "narrow" | "wide" | "sidebar" | "media" | "card" | "hero";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Card from "../compose/Card.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Prose from "../compose/Prose.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import Pill from "../components/pill.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { htmlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title = "",
  content,
  media,
  meta,
  aside,
  level = 2,
  layout = "narrow",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<RichTextProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :heading="{ level }"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :measure="
      ((layout as string) === 'narrow') || ((layout as string) === 'media') ? '2xl'
      : (layout as string) === 'card' ? '3xl'
      : 'default'
    "
    :boxed="((layout as string) === 'card')"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Group
      v-if="(meta?.date || meta?.author || meta?.category)"
      gap="4"
      align="center"
      class="flex-wrap"
      data-testid="richtext-meta"
    >
      <Text v-if="meta?.date" size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ meta?.date }}
      </Text>
      <Text v-if="meta?.author" size="sm" weight="semibold">
        {{ meta?.author }}
      </Text>
      <Pill v-if="meta?.category" tone="blue">
        {{ meta?.category }}
      </Pill>
    </Group>
    <MediaFrame v-if="(((layout as string) === 'hero') || ((layout as string) === 'media'))"
      :alt="(media?.alt ?? title)"
      :src="media?.src"
      :ratio="(((layout as string) === 'hero') ? '21/9' : '16/9')"
    />
    <Grid v-if="((layout as string) === 'sidebar')" cols="1" class="gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <Box class="min-w-0 lg:col-span-2">
        <Prose v-if="content" size="base" width="none" data-testid="richtext-content" :innerHTML="htmlOf(content)" />
      </Box>
      <Card v-if="aside?.content" variant="compact" class="h-fit" data-testid="richtext-aside">
        <Title v-if="aside?.title" :as="((level === 1) ? 2 : 3)" size="lg" weight="semibold">
          {{ aside?.title }}
        </Title>
        <Prose
          v-if="aside?.content"
          size="sm"
          width="none"
          data-testid="richtext-aside-content"
          :innerHTML="htmlOf(aside?.content)"
        />
      </Card>
    </Grid>
    <Prose v-else-if="content"
      size="base"
      :width="
        (layout as string) === 'wide' ? 'wide'
        : (layout as string) === 'hero' ? 'narrow'
        : 'none'
      "
      data-testid="richtext-content"
      :innerHTML="htmlOf(content)"
    />
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
